summary: Precise, reliable and traceable calibration for a wide range of instruments and equipment, helping industries, institutions and hospitals meet quality, safety and regulatory requirements.
intro: JIE provides precise, reliable and traceable calibration for a wide range of instruments and equipment, helping industries, institutions and hospitals meet quality, safety and regulatory requirements.

Calibration covers mechanical and pressure, electro-technical, thermal and temperature, fluid and flow, medical and bio-medical, and civil, construction and material testing instruments. Simple and cost-effective pricing is part of the service approach, with calibration restricted to the equipment necessary to meet product-liability and safety requirements and, where relevant, BIS and ISO standards.
onSiteNote: On-site calibration is available for selected instruments and equipment, including surface plates, Trimos, bench centers, CMMs, hardness testers, UTM, FTM, CTM and pressure gauges.

faq.question: Which calibration disciplines does JIE cover?
faq.answer: Mechanical and pressure, electro-technical, thermal and temperature, fluid and flow, medical and bio-medical, and civil, construction and material testing.

faq.question: Is calibration traceable to national or international standards?
faq.answer: Certification is maintained and updated, traceable to National / International Standards.

faq.question: Can instruments be calibrated at our own facility?
faq.answer: On-site calibration is available for selected instruments, including surface plates, Trimos, bench centers, CMMs, hardness testers, UTM, FTM, CTM and pressure gauges. Calibration is performed at your facility, saving time and travel cost, and refers to BIS and ISO standards.

faq.question: What documentation is provided?
faq.answer: Documentation is intended to satisfy industry, technical-institute, medical-institute, hospital, government-project, regulatory and audit requirements.

faq.question: What happens if an instrument is outside tolerance?
faq.answer: Where tools or equipment are outside specified tolerance, JIE carries out repairs or adjustments wherever possible to bring them back within specified limits. Minor repair work is free of charge; major repair work is charged extra at actual.
